description: Change patient sex to male; replace postpartum hemorrhage with significant hemorrhage after surgery
presentation: A 27-year-old man has had persistently mild thrombocytopenia for 3 years, with platelet counts ranging from about 100k to 150k per microliter. His count is currently 110k. He reports that the low counts first appeared after a significant hemorrhage following surgery. He has no history of liver disease, splenomegaly, transfusions, or a family history of blood disorders. Other blood counts, kidney function, and basic labs have been unremarkable. What is the recommended management for his thrombocytopenia?
